name: Gluckserhütte
beschreibung:
Perched high on the sunny slopes of Mount Glungezer above Tulfes, Gluckserhuette offers rustic alpine character, delicious lodge specialties, and cosy sleeping quarters for mountain enthusiasts.

The Glungezer cable car, the celebrated Zirbenweg trail, and winter ski slopes are right on the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: The Gluckserhuette alpine lodge in Tulfes provides rustic mountain charm and panoramas on Mount Glungezer.
